high_level_description: This image captures a lively concert scene at the Reading Festival. The setting is an outdoor stage with a large crowd of enthusiastic fans in the foreground. The stage is illuminated by bright lights, creating a vibrant atmosphere. The backdrop features a prominent red banner with the word "READING" written in bold yellow letters, indicating the name of the festival. The crowd is densely packed, with many people raising their hands in the air, some holding up phones to record the performance.
